newsitem.title: USA: Alyn wins Boralyn pact with True Temper.
newsitem.headline: Alyn wins Boralyn pact with True Temper.

text.p: Alyn Corp, a maker of advanced metal composite materials, on Wednesday said golf club maker True Temper Sports will begin making club shafts with Alyn's high performance material called Boralyn.
Financial details of the agreement were undisclosed. Alyn's shares shares were up 3/8 to 11-7/8 by midday.
The first shipment of Boralyn shafts is expected in the fourth quarter of 1997.
True Temper Sports is a wholly owned unit of Black & Decker Corp, and it is the largest producer of golf club shafts in the world, Alyn said.
